en.title: Largest Value of Usage in Minutes
en.description:
Each record contains a five-letter lowercase device_id and a four-digit usage (leading zeros allowed); return the device ID with the largest usage. Device IDs are pairwise distinct, and so are the usage values.

The parts marked 'added by this site' and the standard input/output protocol were explicitly compiled by this site; they do not mean the original problem has other unstated rules.
en.input: The first line contains n; each of the next n lines is device_id usage. This site's input protocol omits the comma and space of the original format to resolve the contradiction between its length=10 and the length of the example strings. 1≤n≤1400; each ID is exactly 5 lowercase English letters; usage is interpreted as an integer with 1≤usage≤1400 (the intersection of the original prose and constraints).
en.output: Output the device_id with the largest usage.
en.explanation: See the accompanying editorial for the approach, proof of correctness, and complexity.
